rulings: Source: ar_after governs (district first: يقع في حي الرفعة الشمالية بالهفوف بجوار قصر إبراهيم; ويجاور المقهى حيَّ الكوت); en_after agrees. (1) Location sentence: 05 「它坐落在胡富夫的里法阿北区，紧邻易卜拉欣宫，于 2025 年开业。」 already follows the regenerated order (district, then the palace). 里法阿北区 is verbatim from the termbase (Al-Raf'ah North, batch-indexes) and from the card area_zh 里法阿北区——胡富夫; city-的-district order matches line precedent (palm-location ruling, wafrah-winter). Dropping 古老的 is correct: it described Al-Koot, not North Al-Rifaa. The blind reader placed the café in 里法阿北区 without hesitation (title, area field and body agree), which is what this ruling decides; so no judge edit. Her momentary inference that the palace too is in 里法阿北区 (point 5 / directed a) comes from the source's own structure (the palace's quarter is only named in the Al-Koot sentence, as in ar/en) and resolves on the same paragraph; recasting the location sentence to name the palace's quarter early would import the Al-Koot sentence's content into it, beyond the narrow mission. Deducted 2 under nativeness for that pause. (2) Al-Koot sentence: 「与咖啡馆相邻的库特区是胡富夫最古老的街区……」 renders ويجاور المقهى حيَّ الكوت exactly (neighbouring quarter, not the café's quarter); 库特区 per termbase; rest of the sentence byte-identical; the walking-circuit clause still holds (adjacent quarter). (3) Map lead: 点击 kept, proposed = current. 点击 is the standard Chinese UI verb for both mouse click and touch tap and never carried the touch-only sense of المس/Tap; the blind reader confirmed it reads naturally on laptop and phone (directed b). It does not repeat the title verb 选. Guard proposal, limited to this ruling: in the built /zh/restaurants-cafes/7st/ body, require 里法阿北区 and forbid 古老的库特区 and 所在的库特区; in HOME_COPY.zh.map.lead, forbid touch-only verbs 触摸/轻触/轻点 (点击 stays allowed). No other assertion.
blind_disposition: In scope and handled: point 5 / directed (a) — café district read correctly; palace-district pause recorded and deducted, not edited (see rulings). Directed (b) — confirms 点击 for both devices. OUT OF SCOPE (already-published sentences, not edited, not deducted; for the owner): point 1 均由店家自行命名 reads as redundant (source: يسمّيهما بنفسه); point 2 城堡 in 紧邻城堡的 7st Al-Bait is unidentified (source: بجوار القصر = Qasr Ibrahim; could become 紧邻易卜拉欣宫 or 紧邻该宫 in a later batch); point 3 黄金地带 unclear as place name vs. prime location; point 4 transliteration Maqha Shari' 7 gives no meaning; point 6 nearby-attractions widget lists only 哈米迪耶集市, not 易卜拉欣宫; point 7 ratings/hours note shown with no ratings or hours on the page; point 8 stray 卡拉山页面 → line is an artifact of the dist cut from the previous chapter, not a site defect.

positions.current: 7st 咖啡馆的店名同时用阿拉伯文（音译 Maqha Shari' 7）和拉丁字母“7st”两种文字书写。它坐落在胡富夫古老的库特区，紧邻易卜拉欣宫，于 2025 年开业。这里以精品咖啡与意式浓缩咖啡为主打。咖啡馆在哈萨另设两家分店，均由店家自行命名：紧邻城堡的 7st Al-Bait，以及位于黄金地带萨拉姆区内的 7st Al-Kinnah。它所在的库特区是胡富夫最古老的街区，区内有易卜拉欣宫和贾布里清真寺，一直延伸到凯撒利亚集市，这家咖啡馆恰好处在老城步行游览的范围之内。除精品咖啡外，店内还供应多种饮品与甜点。
